text:
maria: quick question — should our SDKs expose a single "paginator" primitive that is the canonical way to do pagination + retries across py/ts/go? thinking: unify cursor+offset, provide sync+async ergonomics, and pluggable transport hooks for idempotency metadata. :thinking:

alex: +1 on a single primitive, but sync vs async ergonomics are tricky. python wants __iter__/__aiter__, ts wants AsyncIterable, go will probably be a channel or iterator struct. also: avoid hidden threads/loops that block eventloops.

tj: sketched some quick shapes (very rough):
```python
# python sync/async unified shape
class Paginator:
    def __init__(self, call_fn, *, page_size=None, resume_token_key='cursor'):
        ...
    def __iter__(self):
        yield from self._sync_pages()
    async def __aiter__(self):
        async for p in self._async_pages():
            yield p
```
```ts
// ts async iterable
class Paginator<T> implements AsyncIterable<T> {
  constructor(fn, opts) {}
  async *[Symbol.asyncIterator]() { /* yield items or pages */ }
}
```
```go
// go iterator pattern
type Paginator struct { /* Next() (Page, error) */ }
```

diana: we also need clear retry semantics per-page vs per-item. e.g. if a page fails mid-stream do we retry the whole page, resume from token, or bubble error? needs idempotency hints from transport so we can choose safe defaults.

maria: agreed. proposal: default = attempt exponential backoff on transient network errors at the page level; expose a "resume_token" that callers can persist. also provide a hook: on_retry(context) => can modify headers (for idempotency-key) or decide to escalate. sample config: `paginator = Paginator(call, retries=3, backoff=exp(200ms, x2), transport_hooks=[attach_idempotency])`

alex: performance caveat: don't do automatic aggressive prefetching in the default Paginator (makes tail latency worse). make prefetch opt-in with concurrency controls. also document memory/lifetime implications for kv-cache.

tj: naming suggestion: `PagedStream` vs `Paginator`. I prefer `PagedStream` for clarity that it's a stream of items/pages. add `.resume_token` and `.as_pages()` convenience.

diana: add tests matrix: python sync/async parity, ts async iterator, go iterator + simulated network failures and partially delivered pages. also add fuzzing for cursor corruption.

build-bot: created issue #4823 (sdk: paged-stream primitive + transport hooks) assigned to @maria, @tj, due 2024-02-15

maria: next steps I propose: (1) small RFC with example APIs for each language (2) prototype in py + ts (3) land transport hook interface in the common transport layer. volunteers? @tj can you sketch the TS shape, I will do python prototype, @alex can you review perf constraints?

tj: I can do the ts sketch this week. :+1:

alex: will review perf notes and add benchmarks for prefetch vs no-prefetch.

diana: i'll write the test plan and failure-mode matrix.

maria: awesome — will open the RFC today and ping folks. :rocket:
